title: Happy families
intro: Nothing makes us happier than seeing our puppies in loving homes! Here are some beautiful moments shared by our amazing clients after welcoming their furry friends.

quote.text: TeddyPups truly made our dream a reality. They supported us at every step of the import journey. Our Maltipoo arrived healthy, cheerful, and absolutely perfect. Having 24/7 support throughout the process gave us complete peace of mind.
quote.name: Sarah M.

footer: every one of them was a Teddy Pup once
